job.job_description:
About This Role

We're looking for an AI Agent Engineer to design and build autonomous AI systems that can reason, plan, and execute complex workflows. You'll work on multi-agent architectures, tool integrations, and real-world deployments for enterprise clients.

What You'll Do

Design and implement autonomous AI agent systems using frameworks like LangGraph, AutoGen, or custom solutions
Build robust tool-calling pipelines and API orchestration layers
Develop evaluation frameworks to measure agent reliability and performance
Collaborate with clients to understand workflows and translate them into agentic solutions
Research and implement state-of-the-art techniques in AI planning and reasoning

What We're Looking For

Must Have

3+ years of Python development experience
Deep understanding of LLMs, prompting strategies, and chain-of-thought reasoning
Experience with agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen)
Strong understanding of RAG systems and vector databases
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail

Nice to Have

Experience with multi-agent orchestration
Knowledge of reinforcement learning or planning algorithms
Contributions to open-source AI projects
Experience building production AI systems at scale
Tech Stack
Python
LangGraph
LangChain
OpenAI API
Anthropic Claude
Pinecone
PostgreSQL

What We Offer

Competitive salary with equity
Fully remote with flexible hours
Learning budget for conferences and courses
Health insurance coverage
Annual team retreats
How We Work
Async-first communication
Weekly sync meetings
Quarterly OKR planning
Direct access to founders
